subject.title: fix(qa-channel): add timeout to qa-bus state guarded fetch

question: Should getQaBusState intentionally expose a caller-configurable timeout through the QA plugin SDK, or should the short override remain internal to regression tests?
rationale: The production fix needs a deadline, but the PR states that the new option exists only for hermetic tests; deciding whether it should become a lasting SDK contract requires owner intent.

options.title: Keep Override Internal
options.body: Retain the 10-second production timeout, preserve the existing public facade signature, and expose a private helper or injected test seam for short regression deadlines.

options.title: Approve Public Timeout
options.body: Keep the optional SDK parameter, document its supported semantics, and add contract coverage demonstrating why source consumers need to control it.

recommendation.title: Keep Override Internal
recommendation.body: Retain the 10-second production timeout, preserve the existing public facade signature, and expose a private helper or injected test seam for short regression deadlines.
